title: 경찰병원 임상연구비 지급규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00007:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 7 (Duties of Researchers)
(1) A person eligible to receive research expenses under Article 5 shall conduct research in accordance with a research plan approved by the Director of the National Police Hospital (including an approved amended research plan; hereinafter the same shall apply) and shall submit at least one interim report on research progress during the research period.
(2) A person eligible to receive research expenses under Article 5 shall submit a final report under the research plan approved by the Director of the National Police Hospital by the date designated by the Director.
(3) A person who has received research expenses shall not use those expenses for any purpose other than the relevant research purpose.
